comment: Params 1, 2, 4, 6 and 10 are declared in the enum as reserved and have no widget, so they cannot be clicked. Output index 1 is the upper jack printed OUT and index 0 the lower jack printed LFO, the reverse of the index order. OUT is given no family because what it carries changes with whether the input jack is patched: the folded external signal, or the built-in sine with no folding.
